evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 459.
findings: 0-Ki Power Up Super. After the pose animation, the user gains a Basic Movement Speed increase for 20 seconds; current skill-specific documentation identifies the effect as a movement-speed buff rather than a damage or defensive modifier. Exact speed multiplier and frame timing remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
